content.short: Chainsight provides universal on-chain data access across all blockchains.
content.description: Chainsight unifies fragmented on-chain data across Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, and Arbitrum, making historical data from multiple networks readily accessible. As a universal data extension layer, it enables retrieving information from any blockchain through smart contracts, improving transparency and reducing reliance on trust points. With Chainsight, developers and users gain a comprehensive view of data from the entire blockchain universe, enabling informed decisions and cross-chain analytics.
